title: Raise the Shields
story: Hostile objects approach. Shields should activate only when energy is sufficient AND danger is present.
lesson: Use 'and' when both conditions must be true. Logical operators combine Boolean expressions.
objective: shields_up(energy, danger) should return True only when energy >= 20 and danger is True.
hint: Build two expressions, then connect them with 'and'. One expression checks the number; the other is the Boolean parameter.
